blocks.text: PENONOMÉ, Panama—A powerful magnitude 7.7 earthquake rocked Panama on Friday, causing buildings and roads to collapse in the center of the country. There were no immediate reports of casualties. The shallow tremor was felt across the Central American nation of around 4.5 million people, according to the National Civil Protection System.
